bottomContent:
Countries & Cities Online

Countries & Cities (also known as Stadt Land Fluss, Scattergories, or Państwa-Miasta) is a classic word game — now playable online with friends, family or your team, for free, on any device. Create a room, share the code and start playing in under a minute.

A random letter is drawn. All players race to fill in categories — countries, cities, animals, names, and more — with words starting with that letter. Unique answers score more points, so think creatively!

Perfect for game nights, remote team building, parties, and classrooms. Supports 2-12 players, multiple rounds, custom categories, and built-in scoring with challenge voting. Works on desktop, tablet and mobile — no download, no signup.
